Container.Name: ogai-local
Container.Overview: Local inference + agent API (REST, SSE, MCP) for the Open-Generative-AI fork. Runs upstream's local-model engines on the GPUs behind the GPU arbiter; GPU jobs stay disabled until OGAI_GPU_ENABLED=1. Give it GPUs with --gpus device=<uuid> (deploy.sh: OGAI_GPU_DEVICES); it can only use cards the container can see.

Config.Name: API Token
Config.Description: Bearer token required by every endpoint except /health (deploy.sh generates one in AppData/.mcp-token)

Config.Name: GPU Arbiter URL
Config.Description: gpu-arbiter base URL; V100 jobs are refused without it

Config.Name: Enable GPU jobs
Config.Description: 1 = allow GPU jobs. Keep 0 until a GPU test window is approved.

Config.Name: Allowed devices
Config.Description: Which GPUs jobs may use. v100 needs the arbiter and evicts the Hermes brain; gtx1080 never does.

Config.Name: CUDA index V100
Config.Description: CUDA index of the V100 INSIDE the container

Config.Name: CUDA index GTX 1080
Config.Description: CUDA index of the GTX 1080 INSIDE the container (0 if it is the only GPU passed in)
